message: ソバには似合わぬ場所

name: Synn
message: 「Are we all good with this tracklist for the dance?」

name: Everyone
message: 「No objections!」

name: Ria
message: 「A dance, huh... *sigh*...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Ria-senpai, do you hate dancing?」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, it's not like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've seen right through you! You're actually bad at dancing, aren't you, Senpai-san! *Sparkle*」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!」

name: Misa
message: 「There is no way someone like Onee-sama would be! I am certain she dances as gracefully as a swan!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right, I'm a swan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, now I'm really looking forward to it」

name: Ria
message: 「Just hope I don't end up looking like a dying swan...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan's boobs bouncing boing-boing--」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, that wraps up today's Student Council activities!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Done and done!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, have you been working on the assignment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh. Don't remind me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, let's head home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. I'm meeting up with Sacchin today」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're late!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, she had Student Council duties, so don't be unreasonable」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I've got my own code of honor to uphold, ya know! Stand back and mind your manners!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Think before you open your mouth, would ya」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If we don't hurry, the library's gonna close!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Is that really surprising? It's almost time to go home, so of course the library is closing」

name: Misa
message: 「No, it's just hearing the word 'library' come out of Takahashi-san's mouth...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was so unexpectedly shocking that it didn't even occur to me to be surprised」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're all so meaan. Nana-chan, comfort meee」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, let's get going before it's too late」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She won't comfort meee」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you going to borrow a book on sweets or something?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Gulp! I-It's not like that at all, ahahaha」

name: Synn
message: 「Then something about soba?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are soba and sweets the only things on my mind to you?! I'm a delicate maiden too, ya know!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You don't need to apologize, Synn, I mean, well, I guess I can't really blame you for saying that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You just admitted it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urk, d-did not! There's plenty more to me than that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya later. Synn-kun, I'm borrowing Nana-chan, so don't get jealous, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Who's jealous of who?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You jealous of meee」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't be」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You never know these dayyys」
Sacchin isn't into girls like that, so it should be fine.
Wait--would I actually get jealous if she were into girls, or if it were a guy instead!?

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, why is the one who said we were running late standing around chatting?! See ya, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah」
Come to think of it, it's pretty rare for Nanaka to turn me down when I ask to walk home together, especially when it's not even a club activity day.
Well, at our age, being together all the time would be weird anyway. Not that we're actually together all the time or anything.

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. Your focus is slipping.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... was it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's take a quick break.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, it's starting to take shape.」

name: Synn
message: 「I hope so...」

name: Paqy
message: 「They say 'protecting the world' sounds nice, but it's hard to really feel it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Where'd that come from?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, I just remembered. The previous lord used to say that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Dad did?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. That's why he said you become the Demon Lord by picturing the faces of the people you want to protect.」
Nanaka's face popped into my head.

name: Paqy
message: 「Did Soba's face just pop into your head or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「...N-No, it didn't」

name: Synn
message: 「If it were you, Paqy, it'd be Senior Ria, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「For Ria-chan, I'd become the Demon Lord and cleave the whole world in two with a single blow!」

name: Synn
message: 「You wouldn't be protecting anything then」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah」
